title: 第3章 可否引我入仙途第4章 灵途九境登天化仙
slug: 凡人修仙捡个仙子做老婆
content_zh:
周元正畅想自己跟仙子结了缘，从此踏上仙途，却见女子面露痛苦之色，片刻之后，娇躯轻轻颤动，嘴角竟溢出了血水。
“仙子，你……怎么了？”
周元心里咯噔一下，不是已经解了毒吗，难道还有内伤？
女子气息萎靡，呼吸凌乱，从腰间的锦袋里取出一个莹润的玉瓶，往嘴里放了一颗药丸。她眼帘低垂，双手掐诀放在膝上，周身隐隐泛起晶莹的光华。
这是在疗伤吗？
周元见状不再打扰，转身就要关上房门，却听到旁边院子里传来熟悉的怒骂。
“我呸！还仙子？我看你是还没醒酒吧？”
话音未落，齐寡妇已经裹着棉袍，气势汹汹地跑了过来，看到门里的周元，又是一阵厌弃。
“怎么又回来了？”
“赖着我们了是吧？”
“我倒要看看什么是仙子，你给我起开，瘦的跟个蚂蚱似的，也敢拦我？”
齐寡妇骂骂咧咧的走进土屋，狠狠地瞪了周元一眼，可当她的目光落到床上那女子时，整个人都愣住了。
好标致的姑娘。
肌肤赛雪，眉目如画，真跟个玉做的瓷娃娃似得，连她这个自诩艳冠山野的村花，都忍不住自惭形秽。
难道……
真是仙子？
肉体凡胎绝对长不得如此美妙。
“快出来，千万别冒犯仙子。”
宋奎捂着腰，呲牙咧嘴的追过来。
齐寡妇惊醒过来，刚想对仙子行礼，却敏锐的察觉到了不对劲儿，床上那女子的嘴角挂着血迹，秀眉微蹙，绝美的脸上隐隐露出痛苦之色。

难道……
仙子受伤了？
也是啊，如果不是受了伤，这等仙子怎么会落到他们这穷乡僻壤？
想到这里，齐寡妇心头一热，快步来到床前。
她可不会傻到要冒犯仙子，而是想要施救。
仙子落难，千载难逢的仙缘啊。
他们如果出手相助，博得好感，随手赏下几个仙符，传授几门仙法，那样她岂不是也能永葆青春？
到那时候，村子里那些长舌妇谁还敢在背后嚼舌根？
靠着仙家手段，她甚至能住进县城，享受一辈子的荣华富贵！
“仙子，您需要什么草药吗？家里什么都有。”
齐寡妇满是脂粉的脸上露出讨好的笑容，声音都柔了八度。
“家里还有草药？”
周元忍不住皱眉，爷爷当年给他积攒的那些宝药，早就被这对奸夫淫妇卖光了。
“闭嘴！”
齐寡妇恶狠狠的瞪了眼周元，低声喝斥：“滚出去！”
周元冷哼了声，站在原地纹丝不动。
“我让你滚出去，你耳朵聋了吗？还想不想吃饭了？”
齐寡妇不断用眼神凶着周元，这女子虽然是周元带回来的，但不能让救命的恩情落到他身上，必须赶紧支开，好让他们夫妻来‘伺候’仙子。
见周元还是不动，齐寡妇扭头朝着外面喊：“你个死鬼还愣着干什么，快滚进来！”
“干……干什么？”

宋奎忘不了女子的神奇手段，哆哆嗦嗦的迈进来半只脚，又下意识的缩了回去。
“把这小子给我拽出去啊。”
content_en:
Zhou Yuan was imagining that he had formed a bond with a fairy and would embark on the path to immortality from then on, but he saw a look of pain on the woman's face. After a moment, her delicate body trembled slightly, and blood overflowed from the corner of her mouth.
"Fairy, what's wrong with you?"
Zhou Yuan's heart skipped a beat. Hasn't the poison been detoxified? Is there still internal injuries?
The woman's breath was weak and her breathing was messy. She took out a shiny jade bottle from the brocade bag at her waist and put a pill in her mouth. Her eyes were lowered, her hands were kneading on her knees, and there was a faint glimmer of light all over her body.
Is this healing?
Zhou Yuan saw this and stopped disturbing him. He turned around and was about to close the door when he heard a familiar angry curse coming from the yard next to him.
"Bah! Return to the fairy? I take it you haven't woken up yet?"
Before she finished speaking, Widow Qi was already wrapped in a cotton robe and ran over aggressively. When she saw Zhou Yuan at the door, she felt disgusted again.
"Why are you back again?"
"You're relying on us, right?"
"I want to see what a fairy is. How dare you stop me even though you are as skinny as a grasshopper?"
Widow Qi walked into the earthen house cursing and glared at Zhou Yuan, but when her eyes fell on the woman on the bed, she was stunned.
What a pretty girl.
Her skin was as white as snow and her features were as picturesque as a porcelain doll made of jade. Even she, a village beauty who prided herself on being the most beautiful girl in the world, couldn't help but feel ashamed of herself.
Could it be...
Really a fairy?
A mortal body would never be able to look so beautiful.
"Come out quickly and don't offend the fairy."
Song Kui covered his waist and chased after him with a grin on his face.
Widow Qi woke up with a start. She was about to salute the fairy, but she was keenly aware that something was wrong. The woman on the bed had blood stains on her mouth, her beautiful eyebrows were slightly frowned, and there was a faint look of pain on her beautiful face.
Could it be...
The fairy is injured?
That's right. If they weren't injured, how could these fairies end up in a remote place like theirs?
Thinking of this, Widow Qi felt hot and quickly came to the bed.
She was not stupid enough to offend the fairy, but wanted to save her.
The fairy is in trouble, a once-in-a-lifetime fate.
If they helped her, won her favor, rewarded her with a few immortal talismans, and taught her some immortal techniques, wouldn't she also be able to stay young forever?
By then, who among those tongue-tied women in the village would dare to gossip behind their backs?
With the help of the Immortal Family, she could even live in the county town and enjoy a lifetime of prosperity and wealth!
"Fairy, do you need any herbs? We have everything at home."
Widow Qi had a flattering smile on her rosy face, and her voice softened an octave.
"Are there any herbs at home?"
Zhou Yuan couldn't help but frown. All the precious medicines his grandfather had saved for him had long been sold by this adulterer and adulteress.
"Shut up!"
Widow Qi glared at Zhou Yuan fiercely and shouted in a low voice: "Get out!"
Zhou Yuan snorted coldly and stood motionless.
"I told you to get out. Are you deaf? Do you still want to eat?"
Widow Qi kept glaring at Zhou Yuan with fierce eyes. Although this woman was brought back by Zhou Yuan, she could not let the kindness of saving her life fall on him. She had to move away quickly so that the couple could 'serve' the fairy.
Seeing that Zhou Yuan still didn't move, Widow Qi turned her head and shouted outside: "You damn ghost, why are you still standing there, get out of here!"
"Do...what?"
Song Kui couldn't forget the woman's magical method. He stepped forward with one foot tremblingly, then subconsciously retracted it.
"Drag this kid out of here."
